app.name: Wii Save Seeder
app.short_description: Seed missing Wii saves into real NAND
app.long_description: Installs a SaveGame Manager GX extracted disc-game save into real Wii NAND without requiring the game to be launched once first. Backs up uid.sys, creates a missing disc-title UID, creates the save directory with the correct owner UID, then copies the save files. Refuses to overwrite an existing save.
